root_idea.summary: The root centers on bringing something down from a higher position.
root_idea.development: From physical lowering and unloading, usage develops into putting down burdens, requesting their removal, abating prices, descending, and figurative lowering. Related descriptions extend the idea to smoothing or flattening; some derived forms develop specialized senses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The supplied Quranic noun is a distinct, Quran-attested lexical form.

senses.definition: A petition that burdens be put down; in the Quranic formula, a request for the removal of sins and forgiveness.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the command قُولُوا حِطَّةٌ. The burden may be understood literally, while the Quranic interpretation commonly applies it figuratively to sins and their removal.

senses.definition: A declaration or request of alighting and abiding in a town.
senses.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of the Quranic command, connecting the noun with alighting and settling rather than explicitly with the removal of sins.
An alternative interpretation of the Quranic command, understood as an instruction to speak correctly or appropriately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put or throw something down, unload it, or make it descend from a higher place; also to pay something down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of loads removed from animals, saddles and similar objects, and things made to descend from above to below.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To alight and settle or abide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Literally, to put down one's saddle; the expression may refer to staying in a place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove, scatter, or skim something away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of removing leaves from a branch or taking froth from milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower or degrade someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of bringing something down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abate or reduce an amount from a price or debt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْ for an amount taken off a price or debt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a price to become low or cheap, or to fall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use referring specifically to prices.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a camel to bear toward one side while moving; also, to move with vehement speed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage describing an animal's manner or speed of movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline toward someone or something with one's affection or disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of emotional inclination or turning toward a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To launch into or persist in reviling someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative construction with فِي and a person's reputation or honor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat food, or to eat much of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction describing vigorous or extensive eating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To polish, smooth, figure, decorate, or rule leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action is performed with a مِحَطّ, an instrument for working leather.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become put down, descend, or go down from above to below; figuratively, to become lowered or degraded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or quasi-passive derived form; the same form is also used of descending a declivity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go back or backward, go away, or perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A further figurative use of the derived form, attested as an alternative lexical development.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to put down or remove a burden, including a figurative burden of sin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may refer to a real load or, figuratively, to sins or guilt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask, demand, or desire an abatement from a price.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْ to specify the price or amount from which a reduction is sought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deserve to be lowered or degraded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the derived form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become quick in walking, going, or working.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized reduplicated form describing speed or brisk activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for Ramadan.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized designation explained by the idea that fasting the month removes some sin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A decrease or diminution in rank or station.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use referring to low or diminished social standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smooth or sleek bodies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural descriptive use, explained as though the bodies had been polished with a tool.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A declivity or place of descent, especially a hill difficult to descend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of terrain or a place by which one goes down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An excellent, swift she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative descriptive use associated with rapid movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ankle-bone covered with flesh and fat so that it is not prominent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily descriptive expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An amount abated or deducted from a price.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the reduction itself; its plural is حَطَائِطُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low or cheap price.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial adjective applied to a price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smooth in the two portions of flesh and sinew alongside the backbone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily descriptive use referring to smoothness of the back's contours.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where loads are put down, where one alights and settles, or where ships are unloaded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes a physical place of lowering, unloading, or arrival and settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The meaning, point, or intended import of a saying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression extending the idea of a place where something comes to rest to the point of a statement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument for polishing, smoothing, figuring, decorating, ruling, or otherwise working leather; also a pointed tool used by craftsmen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The tool may be made of iron or wood and is used in leatherwork, tattooing, sewing, bookbinding, and related crafts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Put down, especially of a load or similar object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle preserves the literal result of حَطَّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reduced or lowered in price.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application to a price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Polished or smoothed leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of worked leather.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword made thin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application of thinning or smoothing by removal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having bodily contours that are smooth, even, extended, or flattened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used descriptively of a rump, back, or flank; the examples do not impose a restriction to any one gender or body type.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shoulder joint of especially beautiful form, neither high nor low.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical and aesthetic description.

cautions: The Quranic noun حِطَّة has multiple reported interpretations; the burden-removal sense is distinguished from alternative readings involving alighting and a right saying.
The supplied QAC data attest only the noun حِطَّة in two Quranic locations; the remaining meanings are broader Classical Arabic usages.
